subject: Embed + Streaming integration: compatibility notes and next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Parker <e.parker@healthvault.com>, Samir Desai <s.desai@healthvault.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embed + Streaming integration: compatibility notes and next steps

Hi Emily / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. Short recap and a proposed set of next steps so we all have the same picture. I tried to keep this tightly focused on the technical requirements you called out plus the commercial/ops asks.

Key pain points you emphasized
- Slow search relevance and inconsistent reranking for clinical content (latency when combining embeddings + cross-encoder rerank)
- High per-token costs for long-context generation in triage flows, especially when streaming is required for partial results
- Data residency / PHI handling: preference for VPC/private deployment or dedicated capacity and need for audit logs

Goals from our side of the call (what success looks like)
1) Embed pipeline that improves recall + rerank without a large latency hit (target P95 < 600ms for rerank step)
2) Streaming response for triage UI with function-calling hooks for structured triage outputs (JSON schema)
3) Clear deployment path that meets audit/KMS requirements and a short procurement path for a pilot

Redwood fit / implementation notes
- Embeddings + Rerank: propose embeddings for candidate retrieval + a light-weight cross-encoder reranker hosted on Dedicated capacity; can colocate reranker with cache to keep P95 under target.
- Streaming & Function Calls: our SDK supports streaming chunks today; we'll add a small wrapper that emits structured JSON objects as they complete and a function-calling contract so your frontend can map partial outputs to the triage UI.
- Structured outputs: recommend defining a canonical JSON schema for the triage result. We'll add schema validation to the SDK to fail-fast on malformed funcall payloads.
- PHI & Deployment: pilot on Dedicated pool with optional Private control plane (VPC). We'll include audit-log export and KMS integration for the pilot.
- Cost controls: recommend token capping per request + prefix caching on patient histories and an aggressive rerank downsampling strategy for older records.

Proposed action items (owners / ETA)
- Aditya: share mutual action plan + pilot SOW draft (attached) — EOD Wed 24 Mar 2027 [attachment: HVT-mutual-action-plan.xlsx]
- Grace: prototype SDK wrapper for streaming->structured outputs and example funcall contract — internal demo Fri 26 Mar 2027
- Jordan: proposed system architecture diagram for Dedicated placement and cache topology — Tue 30 Mar 2027
- Emily / Samir: confirm PHI/legal guardrails required for pilot (KMS preferences, minimal retention windows) and loop in procurement contact — please by Wed 24 Mar 2027

Attachments: healthvault-interop-notes.pdf (notes from call), HVT-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

If that matches your read, I can schedule a short technical deep-dive next week (30–45 minutes) with Grace and Jordan to walk through the SDK wrapper and the Dedicated deployment configuration.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

Subject: Re: Embed + Streaming integration: compatibility notes and next steps

Aditya — thanks for the clear write-up. High level this looks right. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) PHI / deployment: for the pilot we need private control plane + bring-your-own-KMS. We also need a minimal retention window and the ability to run a one-off audit export. I'll confirm the exact retention numbers with security but this is a hard requirement.

2) Rerank latency: target P95 < 600ms is aggressive but aligns with our UX bar. If Dedicated placement helps us hit that we are comfortable trading some cost for consistent latency.

3) Procurement: looping in procurement (procurement@healthvault.com) here — they will need a one-page SOW and a short pricing sheet.

Next step for us: please send the SOW + the mutual action plan and let us know when Grace can demo the SDK wrapper. We're available Wed afternoon (24th) for a quick kickoff or Thu morning depending on your calendar.

Thanks,
Emily Parker
Head of Product, HealthVault
e.parker@healthvault.com | (617) 555-4612

Short internal note and checklist before the technical deep-dive: 

- SDK wrapper: I'll deliver a repo with two example clients (Node + Python) that show streaming partial funcall payloads and local schema validation. Will include an example of emitting early partial structured responses so the UI can render incremental triage suggestions.
- Reranker: propose using a distilled cross-encoder variant on Dedicated; we should test both sequence-length and batch-size to hit the 600ms P95 — I'll include perf numbers in the demo.
- Security checklist: bring-your-own-KMS + audit export are supported on Private control plane; need procurement to confirm SOC2 + any additional attestation.
- Pre-demo tests I want in place: sample corpus of 500 triage items (anonymized), test plan for latency/regression, and a small prompt set to measure rerank stability.

I'll start the SDK prototype today and will share a short repo link before the demo. Jordan — can you sketch the Dedicated placement doc (zones, cache colocations) and drop it into the Drive folder Aditya linked?
